scope: Workspace comparison ranker, isolated unit tests. Run from the repository root.

results.test: requires repeated alternating visits and exposes the evidence and next expiry
coalesces duplicates, drops unknown modules and ignores late observations
abstains when equally plausible pairs compete or the most recent visit breaks the pattern
respects a dismissal through the quiet window and allows a fresh deliberate sequence afterwards
bounds evidence and top-k even when a session is busy and returns isolated snapshots
